title: The *Handover*
dek: The same week Jensen Huang resigned, the market was 6x oversubscribed for Anthropic shares. Every story today is about who gets to hold something.

stories.label: Nvidia fell 9%+ on investigation reports before his exit
stories.headline: The person who built Nvidia's hardware strategy is gone. The roadmap stays, without its author.

stories.label: oversubscribed, with pricing set for November 18 at a ~$1T valuation
stories.headline: At $1 trillion, the market has decided AI risk and value are the same asset.
Public gets Fable 5.2. Vetted researchers get Mythos 5.2. The IPO covers both.

stories.label: token context in Alibaba's cloud-only preview, available until Nov 25
stories.headline: No benchmarks, no weights, no model card. The model exists; take their word for it.

stories.label: of causal DNA variants detected, up from 16% in the prior model
stories.headline: AI finds the needle in the DNA haystack twice as precisely. Clinical validation has not caught up.

stories.label: AI computing supply contract from Naver to a US inference firm
stories.headline: South Korea is now supplying compute to US AI inference at scale.

stories.label: raised at $8.5B valuation, SoftBank-led with Nvidia participating
stories.headline: SoftBank and Nvidia bet on German robotics while Nvidia has no CEO to approve the next bet.

still_signal: Every story this week is a governance decision about access. Nvidia's CEO seat is empty. Anthropic's IPO is 6x oversubscribed. Alibaba published no benchmarks. DeepMind's API is non-commercial only.
